heroHeadline: US measles cases hit 3,294 as Pennsylvania becomes the nation's hardest-hit state — and a coroner confirms measles caused one of its two 2026 deaths
heroSubtitle: CDC's Sept 10 update marks a fifth straight week of triple-digit growth; Pennsylvania alone reached 676 cases across 37 counties, overtaking South Carolina, with 124 hospitalizations and 4 rare vaccinated 'breakthrough' cases. A Lancaster County coroner ruled Sept 9 that measles killed 6-week-old Mary Stoltzfus but was unrelated to newborn Ivan Miller's death, even as Pennsylvania keeps counting both and CDC's federal tally excludes both. New outbreaks also emerged in a metro Atlanta daycare (10 cases) and Illinois's Douglas County. PAHO's US elimination status decision remains due November 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
